integrity: The proof is uniform in both integer parameters. It uses an explicit nonnegative polynomial radical Hilbert matrix, verifies connectedness from its positive off-diagonal degree-two multiplicities, and computes the local Smith exponents over Q[[x-1]] by an exact constant decomposition into the all-ones line and the sum-zero hyperplane. No finite computation is used as a substitute for the universal argument.
scientific_limitations: The result realizes only profiles with one zero and equal negative entries. It does not classify arbitrary connected signed profiles, prove minimality of the number of vertices or radical dimension, or address uniqueness of realizations.
title: Connected square-zero Euler–Smith realizations at arbitrary equal depth
